19_1_1: Oh, the blessedness, the deep and settled happiness of the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, taking their advice as the rule for his life; who does not stand in the way that sinners take; who does not, at the last, sink down into the seat of the mockers.
19_1_2: Instead, his whole delight is set on the instruction of the LORD, and over that instruction he broods, chewing it and murmuring it low to himself, day and night.
19_1_3: He stands like a tree transplanted beside flowing streams, deliberately set where the water never fails, yielding its fruit when its season comes; its leaves stay green and never wither, and whatever such a man sets his hand to ripens and comes through to good.
19_1_4: Not so the wicked, not so at all! They are mere chaff, the dry and weightless husk that the threshing wind lifts and scatters, with nothing to hold it down.
19_1_5: And so the wicked will not stand, unable to rise and hold their ground when the judgment comes; nor will sinners take their place in the assembly of the righteous.
19_1_6: For the LORD intimately knows the way of the righteous; He marks it, guards it, and owns it as His own. But the way of the wicked leads nowhere, and in the end it perishes.
19_23_1: A Psalm of David. The LORD Himself is my shepherd, the One who feeds me, leads me, and guards me as His own, so I shall never lack for any good thing I truly need.
19_23_2: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters that refresh me.
19_23_3: He restores my soul, bringing my life back when it is drained and wandering; and He guides me along the well-worn paths of righteousness, for the honor of His own name is staked on leading me home.
19_23_4: Even when I walk through the valley of deepest darkness -- the very shadow of death, thick with dread -- I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod to drive off the wolves and Your staff to draw me back, they protect and comfort me.
19_23_5: You prepare a table before me, a full feast spread out in the very presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil, welcoming me as an honored guest; and my cup of blessing overflows.
19_23_6: Surely goodness and covenant-love, God's loyal and unbreakable mercy, will pursue me, hunting me down all the days of my life; and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for the length of my days, and on without end.
19_37_1: Do not burn with anger over evildoers, and do not envy those who do wrong.
19_37_2: For like grass they will soon be cut down, and wither like the green plant.
19_37_3: Trust in the LORD and do good; settle in the land and pasture yourself on His faithfulness.
19_37_4: Take exquisite delight in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart -- for when He Himself becomes your joy, He both shapes and satisfies what your heart most wants.
19_37_5: Roll your way onto the LORD -- commit the whole road of your life to Him; lean your trust on Him, and He Himself will bring it to pass.
19_37_6: He will bring out your righteousness like the dawn, and your just cause like the noonday sun.
19_37_7: Rest in the LORD and wait for Him in patient hope; do not let it burn in you when the schemer thrives along his way, when a man pushes his wicked plots through to success.
19_37_8: Let go of anger, and leave wrath behind; do not fret -- it leads a man only into evil.
19_37_9: For evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD will inherit the land.
19_37_10: Yet a little while, and the wicked man is gone; you will search the place where he stood, and he will not be there.
19_37_11: But the humble will inherit the land and luxuriate in the fullness of peace.
19_37_12: The wicked man plots against the righteous, gnashing at him with his teeth in open hatred.
19_37_13: The Lord only laughs at him, for He sees that his day of reckoning is already on its way.
19_37_14: The wicked unsheathe the sword and string the bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to butcher those who walk uprightly.
19_37_15: But their sword will pierce their own heart, and their bows will be shattered.
19_37_16: Better the little that the righteous has than the abundance of many wicked.
19_37_17: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD sustains the righteous.
19_37_18: The LORD watches over the days of those who walk in integrity, and the inheritance they receive endures forever.
19_37_19: They will not be disgraced when disaster comes, and in the days of famine they will eat their fill.
19_37_20: But the wicked will perish; the enemies of the LORD, like the brief beauty of the fields, will soon be scorched -- going up in smoke and consumed away.
19_37_21: The wicked takes a loan and never returns it, but the righteous one is gracious and keeps on giving.
19_37_22: For those He blesses will inherit the land, but those He curses will be cut off.
19_37_23: The steps of a man are made firm by the LORD, and He delights in his way.
19_37_24: Though he stumbles, he will not be hurled headlong, for the LORD holds him up by the hand.
19_37_25: I have been young, and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or his children begging bread.
19_37_26: All day long he deals kindly and lends freely, and his offspring are blessed because of him.
19_37_27: Depart from evil and do good, and you will settle in the land secure forever.
19_37_28: For the LORD loves justice and never abandons His faithful ones; they are kept safe forever, but the offspring of the wicked are cut off.
19_37_29: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
19_37_30: The mouth of the righteous murmurs wisdom, and his tongue speaks what is just.
19_37_31: The law of his God is held within his heart; not one of his steps gives way.
19_37_32: The wicked lies in wait for the righteous, seeking to kill him.
19_37_33: The LORD will not leave him in his enemy's grip, nor let him be declared guilty when he is dragged into court.
19_37_34: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
19_37_35: I have watched a wicked man, ruthless and overbearing, towering and spreading himself like a green tree rooted in its native soil.
19_37_36: Yet he passed away, and there he was -- gone; I searched for him, but he could not be found.
19_37_37: Mark the man of integrity and fix your eyes on the upright, for the man of peace has a future before him.
19_37_38: But rebels will be destroyed together; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
19_37_39: The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
19_37_40: The LORD helps them and rescues them; He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in Him.
